content:
Focus solely on identifying the unique vertices from the SVG path commands, ignoring intermediate moves to the same point. Count the distinct vertices after removing duplicates and closed path returns, then match the vertex count and arrangement to the geometric shape options. 

For the example path:  
Commands move through points (64,63), (44,63), (44,50), (64,50), (64,45), (85,57), (64,68), and back to (64,63). Removing the duplicate start/end point yields 7 unique vertices, forming a heptagon—option (B).
